overview_description.description:
Ngrok is an API-first ingress-as-a-service platform that helps developers get their apps online faster and more securely. Its simplicity has made it a de facto standard tool among developers, and it is recommended throughout the documentation of the world's top technology brands, including Microsoft, GitHub, Okta, Shopify, Zoom, and Twilio. Lightspeed Venture Partners and Coatue have invested in the company.

The company was founded in 2015 and is based in San Francisco, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Ngrok is an API-first ingress-as-a-service platform that helps developers build their apps faster and more securely with no code changes.

product.name: API Gateway
product.description: A developer-friendly solution to manage and route traffic to APIs globally with security and observability features.

product.name: Kubernetes Operator
product.description: A Kubernetes ingress controller that manages traffic and security by integrating with ngrok’s global network.

product.name: Device Gateway
product.description: A solution to standardize and secure connectivity for fleets of IoT devices across external networks.

product.name: Global Load Balancer
product.description: A preconfigured global load balancer that routes traffic to the nearest point of presence for performance and availability.

product.name: Identity-Aware Proxy
product.description: A proxy service that enforces access control to applications and APIs without requiring code changes.

product.name: Secure Tunnels
product.description: A service that creates secure, encrypted tunnels to expose local or remote services without firewall or VPN configuration.
